s1_cancelled: UPDATE queue_sessions SET state = 'cancelled', cancelled_at = TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-19 02:00:00+00', cancel_reason = 'rain' WHERE id = 'a3000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'
s1_closed_to_requests: UPDATE queue_sessions SET accept_join_requests = false WHERE id = 'a3000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'
s1_has_sixty_requests: INSERT INTO session_join_requests (id, club_id, session_id, name, stated_band, placement, status, requested_at, created_at, updated_at, revision) SELECT ('a3400000-0000-4000-8000-0000000' || lpad(i::text, 5, '0'))::uuid, 'c9000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', 'a3000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', 'Waiting ' || i, 'unsure', 'slot', 'pending', TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-19 02:00:00+00', TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-19 02:00:00+00', TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-19 02:00:00+00', 1 FROM generate_series(100, 159) AS i
s2_free_slot: UPDATE session_players SET released_at = TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-16 00:00:00+00', release_reason = 'removed' WHERE id = 'a7000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003'

snapshot.name: queue_sessions
snapshot.sql: SELECT id, state, revision::text AS revision, queue_revision::text AS queue_revision, minimum_games, updated_at FROM queue_sessions ORDER BY id

snapshot.name: session_players
snapshot.sql: SELECT id, session_id, club_player_id, player_id_at_entry, name_snapshot, present, present_changed_at, (SELECT a.source_operation_id FROM club_assessments a WHERE a.id = session_players.assessment_id) AS assessment_operation_id, skill_level_id, level_locked_at, confirmed_at, joined_at, over_budget_at, released_at, release_reason, no_show_at, self_checked_in_at, left_at, revision::text AS revision, created_at, updated_at FROM session_players ORDER BY id

snapshot.name: session_waitlist
snapshot.sql: SELECT id, session_id, club_player_id, skill_level_id, added_at, demoted_at, demoted_confirmed_at, created_at, updated_at, revision::text AS revision FROM session_waitlist ORDER BY id

snapshot.name: session_join_requests
snapshot.sql: SELECT id, session_id, name, nickname, phone_e164, status, placement, requested_at, decided_at, decided_by_device_id, club_player_id, player_id, invite_code_id, stated_band, created_at, updated_at, revision::text AS revision FROM session_join_requests ORDER BY id
